name: codex-sync
description: Capture and synchronize global Codex instructions, native agent profiles, portable settings, providers, marketplaces, and plugins through a private GitHub repository.

interface.longDescription: Connect a selected private GitHub repository, capture reviewed current-device configuration and non-OpenAI plugins, preserve declared externally managed AGENTS sections, preview portable changes, apply them transactionally, auto-provision explicitly approved plugins, reconcile marketplaces and plugins, and roll back when needed.
defaultPrompt: Set up Codex Sync on this device.
Check and apply my synchronized Codex configuration.
Show Codex Sync status and available backups.
